title.zh: 保步映射传递有限历史

claim.zh: 若映射 f 保持每一步关系，则它把每条给定有限历史送到具有相同动作串的目标历史。
claim.en: If f preserves each step relation, it sends every finite trace to a target trace with the same action word.

hypotheses.zh: 给定两个 Process、同一动作类型与逐步保持条件 hstep。
hypotheses.en: Two supplied processes, one action type and the pointwise hstep preservation hypothesis.

correspondence.zh: 状态映射及其实际意义需独立说明；这里只传递已给定历史。
correspondence.en: The state map and its actual meaning require correspondence; this only transports a supplied trace.

detail.zh: 保步不独自给出反向提升；反向需要每个起始纤维的步骤可提升条件。
detail.en: Step preservation alone does not give converse lifting; lifting needs a condition at every starting fiber.

limitations.zh: 保步不独自给出反向提升；反向需要每个起始纤维的步骤可提升条件。
limitations.en: Step preservation alone does not give converse lifting; lifting needs a condition at every starting fiber.

validation_scope.zh: 复用所列既有 Lean 回执；本次仅审读源码、核对声明及回执哈希对应，未重新编译。
validation_scope.en: Credits the linked existing Lean receipt. This migration reads source and checks declaration presence and receipt hash binding; it does not rerun Lean.

next_delta.zh: 其他有限历史保持证明直接复用 trace_map；额外端点或实际对应另列。
next_delta.en: Reuse trace_map for finite-history preservation; additional endpoint or actual correspondence requirements remain explicit.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：迁移既有成果身份与范围；不新增定理，不移动原始资料。
history.en: 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.
